claim: Content flags are a declaration, not a look: they drive audience warnings, auto-populate the negative prompt and soften flash and strobe fx automatically. You set them because the scene already contains the thing — the flag never puts it there.
not_visual: Setting a flag gates and warns rather than generating; it subtracts from the prompt more often than it adds. flashing_lights is temporal by definition, sexual_content is something we will not render at all, and blood or injury appear in a frame only because the shot's own content put them there — which is a different variable's job.
